Initial crystal structures of LaNi₂P₂ and LaNi₂Ge₂

access.notes: Tetragonal ThCr₂Si₂‑type structure, space group I4/mmm (#139). Atomic positions: La 2a (0,0,0), Ni 4d (0,½,¼), P/Ge 4e (0,0,z) with z ≈ 0.36. Typical lattice constants a ≈ 3.99–4.21 Å, c ≈ 9.61–9.96 Å. These are available from the literature or can be built from standard crystallographic data.
